sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Jamba - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Jamba is a hybrid Transformer-Mamba mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model ranging from 52B to 398B total parameters. This model aims to combine the advantages of both model families, the performance of transformer models and the efficiency and longer context (256K tokens) of state space models (SSMs) like Mamba.

sources.title: Jamba LLMs: The Best Long Context Models for Secure Enterprise ... - AI21
sources.snippet: Explore AI21's Jamba models - a family of long-context, hyper-efficient open LLMs built for the enterprise and available for secure self-hosted deployments, such as on-premise and VPC.

sources.title: Jamba - Open Source AI Models
sources.snippet: Jamba 1.5 Large (August 2024) is the current flagship — 398B total parameters with 94B active, native 256K context (effective beyond 140K). Licensed under AI21's open model licence, which permits most commercial use.
